description: Build and run AI agents and workflows visually, with any model and tool.

promotion.reason: Pending since 2026-09-11: not yet proven as offered, because it ran from a binary built before its manifest gained the superuser login Langflow 1.12 requires. Qualification stopped when D: ran out of space; resume with qualify_batch --offered once it is compacted.

risk_notes: Creates 1 Docker container and publishes one port on this computer's loopback interface only.
Generates 1 credential of its own, keeps it beside the app's data, and reuses it if you reinstall.
Keeps its data in this app's managed folder. A keep-data uninstall leaves it; deleting data removes it permanently.
Proven on Windows with Docker's Linux engine. macOS and Linux hosts are unverified.
Written by Local Store from the project's own deployment instructions, not taken from an app store.

config.content:
{
  "id": "langflow",
  "name": "Langflow",
  "version": "1.12.1",
  "source": "https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow",
  "website": "https://www.langflow.org",
  "documentation": "https://docs.langflow.org/deployment-docker",
  "short_desc": "Build and run AI agents and workflows visually, with any model and tool.",
  "categories": [
    "Artificial Intelligence"
  ],
  "license": "MIT",
  "form_fields": [
    {
      "type": "text",
      "label": "Username",
      "min": 3,
      "max": 40,
      "required": true,
      "default": "langflow",
      "env_variable": "LANGFLOW_USERNAME"
    },
    {
      "type": "password",
      "label": "Password",
      "min": 8,
      "max": 80,
      "required": true,
      "env_variable": "LANGFLOW_PASSWORD"
    },
    {
      "type": "random",
      "label": "Encryption key for stored credentials",
      "min": 48,
      "max": 48,
      "env_variable": "LANGFLOW_SECRET_KEY"
    }
  ]
}
